This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and pain, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and act as a natural laxative. The health benefits of Uragoga laxa include its potential use in the treatment of hypertension, insomnia, and anxiety disorders, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
